## What's new in Dropshake v1.2.4

- Refined the shelf header spacing, sizing, and grip so it feels closer to the website design.
- Added the Dropshake icon to the shelf and adjusted selected-file colors to match the brand.
- Improved search-bar spacing while resizing the shelf.
- Restored shift-click selection and made the trash button remove selected files when any are selected.
- Added the Dropshake project website.

## Install

Download `Dropshake.dmg`, open it, drag Dropshake into Applications, then eject the Dropshake disk in Finder. Requires macOS 13 or later. The universal app supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
